frame:
Use case: stylized-concept. Near-photographic cinematic painterly realism for the Korean post-collapse road-trip game Seoul to 400km. Grounded Korean people and infrastructure, restrained cool gray-blue palette, wet or dusty weathered materials, one practical warm amber light source where inhabited, natural anatomy, human-scale action, subtle film grain, believable 35-50mm film-still composition. Match the attached Caravan canonical references exactly in medium, palette, character identity and vehicle design.
anime, manga, comic book, ink outline, cel shading, cartoon, chibi, pixel art, glossy advertising photo, hyperreal skin pores, fashion editorial, studio portrait, 3D render, game-engine screenshot, fantasy, zombies, neon cyberpunk, clean sci-fi vehicle, American RV, panel van, readable text, logo, watermark, UI, frame, collage, split panel
Asset-specific clarification: this is a separate transparent UI MATERIAL component for a design prototype, NOT narrative scene artwork or a gameplay screenshot. The words UI/frame in the negative apply to scene art; for this component specifically the subject IS the material rim or blank button. No letters, numbers, captions, symbols, logos or watermark whatsoever. Canonical images are style/material/color references only. Do not copy their people, vehicles, scenery, writing or collage structure. No characters or complete vehicles. Flat orthographic front elevation, physically grounded, restrained cinematic painterly material realism, no dramatic perspective, no glossy 3D or fantasy ornaments. Large production master.
Primary request: ONE thin rectangular dark blue-gray painted steel rim for a dialogue surface in a lived-in Korean repair truck. A hollow open rectangular frame, outer aspect ratio about 4:5, using almost the full canvas with 4% transparent margin, inner opening truly transparent. Very narrow 18-25 pixel metal strips at a 1024 pixel width, straight calm edges, slightly dulled inner bevel, only four small recessed fastening screws at corners, a few modest paint chips exposing matte steel, sparse soft brown oxidation concentrated at corner joints. No slab backing, no interior fill, no props. The center must be entirely transparent. The frame is functional lightweight trim, not armored equipment. No excessive bolts, sci-fi, gold filigree, leather, rope or spikes. Low-detail straight spans suitable for nine-slice scaling. Single isolated component, crisp edges, genuine alpha.
